technique: 3D CGI character animation (not stop-motion despite a felt/fabric-look shader on skin, hair and clothing) — likely a rigged low/mid-poly toon-shaded model rendered to look handmade. frame_rate_feel: Source is 30fps per metadata.json, and motion across adjacent periodic frames looks continuously smooth rather than stepped or held — pupil, mouth, and glass-hand position all shift in small continuous increments frame to frame, with no visible on-2s/on-3s stutter or duplicate-frame holds.
